name: token-saving-mods
description: Seven Claude Code mods that cut token cost, plus a /mods switchboard, a /savings pane, Helper Desk and Chat Inventory

plugins.name: input-router
plugins.description: Big files and connector results are read by Haiku first; Claude gets short notes and a path to the full thing. A side pane shows each hand-off to Haiku live. /input-router full lets the next one through whole

plugins.name: effort-optimizer
plugins.description: Reads each prompt, picks the effort level it needs with Ben's four-question framework, and offers Switch to that level, or sets it by itself in auto mode

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: BenAI copy of claude-code-templates' Jev Model Router (MIT), changed to use Haiku in place of Jev. Haiku reads each subagent task at agent.spawn and answers in JSON with a tier and a confidence from 0 to 1; a task moves to a cheaper model only when that confidence is at least minDowngradeConfidence. Logs every pick, the model it replaced and the estimated cost difference to ~/.claude/mods-logs/savings.jsonl. No API key and no network call of its own. Never changes the main chat's model; main-chat effort routing is off by default.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Counts down until the chat's prompt cache goes cold, above the prompt. When a big chat goes cold, offers a handoff to a fresh chat. Keep warm pings the cache in the background so it does not go cold

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: At 250k tokens, offers Refresh: writes a handoff of the whole chat, shows the steps with progress bars, then copies it or starts a new chat with it. Logs every run to ~/.claude/handoffs/handoff.log and saves a draft first

plugins.name: research-router
plugins.description: Keeps web research out of the main chat: Haiku shortens Claude's own big search results, and /research-router has a cheap worker or subagents read real pages and give Claude a short brief with sources

plugins.name: efficient-browser-use
plugins.description: Cheaper browser tasks: shrinks every screenshot Claude takes while it drives a browser, or has Haiku describe it in words. /efficient-browser full lets one full-size screenshot through

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: A Mods pane that finds every mod on this Mac by itself, also the ones installed from a marketplace, turns each one on or off in every chat, and opens the side-pane ones

plugins.name: savings-proof
plugins.description: /savings opens the Savings Proof pane: every token the other mods saved, with today's and this chat's totals

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: Helper Desk: a purple task progress bar above the prompt that moves as each to-do item is done, and a side pane with one live card per subagent

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: A side pane, In this chat, that lists the to-do list, connectors, context files and skills this chat used
